Corporate Profile

A Heritage of Trust in Steel Supply

Founded in Kamathipura, the metal-trading hub of Mumbai, Sujal Enterprise has established itself as an authoritative supplier of high-integrity industrial piping parts.

Our foundational focus is simple: bridge the gap between quality manufacturers and on-site EPC executions. We stock a comprehensive range of forged socket-weld fittings, carbon steel pipe bends, flanges, and structural pipe columns.

Whether coordinating micro-tolerances for high-temperature boilers or supplying anti-corrosive duplex fittings for marine pipelines, we ensure full traceability with EN 10204 3.1 Material Test Certificates (MTC) accompanying every shipment.

ASTM & ASME Standards Standardized dimensions for universal pipe fitting replacements.
Verified Dispatching Dual-stage warehousing inspection to eliminate sizes mismatches.

Vision & Mission

Our Vision

To be recognized globally as the most reliable, client-oriented supplier of heavy-duty pipeline infrastructure, pioneering modern distribution logistics.

Our Mission

To supply zero-defect, certified piping products while maintaining cost competitiveness, prompt client deliveries, and robust customer relationship channels.

Core Pillars

Our Commitments

Replacing standard testimonial elements with our core guarantees to industrial buyers.

Quality Commitment

We source raw billets and pipes from premium manufacturers, conducting ultrasonic and hydro-testing to identify internal micro-defects before delivery.

Fast Delivery

We keep standard carbon steel fittings, pipe caps, and flanges pre-stocked in high quantities, facilitating same-day packaging and rapid logistics routing.

Trusted Supplier

Every single transaction is accompanied by verifiable mill test reports. We maintain a zero-claims record for dimensional and material defects.

Wholesale Competitive Pricing

By supplying in bulk direct from Mumbai Central, we minimize supply-chain markups, offering pricing margins that support project profitability.

24/7 Inquiry Support

Our sales engineering desk remains accessible for instant quotes and bid submissions. Contact us via phone, email or WhatsApp.
